_note: Personal source list template. Copy this file to ~/.follow-builders/user-sources.json and replace the examples with your own sources. YouTube entries use @handle or /channel/ID. RSS entries must be a direct feed URL. This file is never overwritten by skill updates.

youtube._comment: Use the @handle format for most channels
youtube.name: Channel Name

youtube._comment: Use /channel/UCxxx format when no @handle is available
youtube.name: Channel Without Handle

youtube._comment: Use /playlist?list=PL... to track a specific playlist instead of a whole channel
youtube.name: Specific Playlist

_categories._note: Categories are free-form labels — use any strings that make sense to you.

_not_trackable._note: Sources that cannot be tracked via RSS or YouTube feeds
examples: X/Twitter accounts — require the X API (only available in the feed generator for fork operators)
TikTok-only creators — no public RSS or YouTube feed
Paywalled content — RSS feeds typically only show free articles
